model_annotation: This plot illustrates the trends of four economic sectors over a series of data points along the x-axis, with labels written in Bulgarian. The x-axis appears to represent time periods or categories, though the specific tick labels are not clearly legible in the image; it contains approximately 10–11 data points arranged linearly from left to right. The y-axis represents a numeric value ranging from 0 to 200,000, with gridlines and tick labels at intervals of 50,000, on a linear scale, and no explicit unit label is shown. The first line, shown in orange, represents "Селско, горско и рибно стопанство" (Agriculture, forestry, and fishing); it remains nearly flat and very close to zero across the entire x-axis. The second line, in gray, represents "Преработваща промишленост" (Manufacturing); it starts near approximately 20,000 at the leftmost data point, remains relatively low through the first several points, then rises sharply in the later points, reaching approximately 190,000 at the rightmost data point. The third line, in yellow, represents "Търговия; ремонт на автомобили и мотоциклети" (Trade; repair of motor vehicles and motorcycles); it stays close to zero for most of the range, with a modest increase in the later data points reaching roughly 10,000–15,000 before slightly declining at the final point. The fourth line, in blue, represents "Създаване и разпространение на информация и творчески продукти; далекосъобщения" (Information and communication); it begins around 25,000–30,000, dips slightly in the middle portion of the x-axis to around 20,000, then rises steeply in the later data points, reaching approximately 175,000–180,000 at the final point, following a trajectory broadly similar to but slightly below the gray line in the rightmost portion of the chart.
